entities.name: Golden-Tail
entities.description: A taciturn kitsune kensei from Kamigawa who trained kitsune samurai and for whom an Academy was named.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: The highest kitsune priest, whom Golden-Tail consulted.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which Golden-Tail trained his kin.

entities.name: Golden-Tail Academy
entities.description: Academy named for him to train samurai for the Imperial Court.

entities.name: Imperial Court
entities.description: The court for which samurai were trained.

entities.name: Kitsune
entities.description: The fox-like people Golden-Tail belonged to.

events.summary: When the Kami War began, Golden-Tail seeks counsel from Eight-and-a-Half-Tails.
Golden-Tail returns silent and redoubles his training of the kitsune, lowering casualties.
events.quote: redoubled his efforts to train his kin in the art of the blade

events.summary: Golden-Tail Academy is created after the Kami War.
events.quote: an Academy named Golden-Tail Academy after him was created

relations.quote: an Academy named Golden-Tail Academy after him
